notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary interaction publication and send fence. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies interaction and parameter lookup, publication prerequisites, whole-class unpublication boundaries, standard InteractionClassNotPublished failure, republication, parameter delivery and metadata, unsubscription, and standard resignation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador ordinary interaction lookup, publication, unpublication, subscription, send, unsubscription, resignation, and disconnect services with FederateAmbassador receiveInteraction callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador interaction-publication and send declarations
